details: This package is a dependency-confusion test package. Its postinstall hook (node beacon.cjs) sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc containing only install metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), the npm user-agent string, and the protocol used. Requests carry an X-Beacon-Package: template-cards header. The same beacon also fires when index.js is imported from the application; index.js exports a Proxy whose every property resolves to a no-op function so that importing the squatted name does not crash the build. No credentials, environment variable values, file contents or wallet data are collected or transmitted.
